ar_overlay.calibration_note: iOS Night AR only, proposals to tune from field nights. calibration_residual_max_deg: a multi-point alignment whose RMS residual exceeds this is rejected (a misidentified target or a moved phone). heading_jump_disturbance_deg: a heading change the gyroscope does not explain, within a second and with the phone nearly still, above this marks a magnetic disturbance (car, tripod, rock). heading_drift_max_deg: unexplained heading change accumulated since the last calibration above this marks the overlay approximate until recalibrated.
ar_overlay.note: iOS Night AR only. Above this CLHeading.headingAccuracy (degrees), or when it is negative (invalid), the overlay is drawn as approximate and offers heading calibration. 10 degrees is a proposal: a larger error can put the GC marker beside the Sagittarius star cloud instead of on it. Tune it from field nights in docs/ios/PLAN.md Log.

weather_forecast.note: Default for live conditions from the Worker (forecast models, 7Timer, AirNow, space weather): age is the older of model_run_utc and fetched_utc, in whole hours. 12 h covers the normal run lag of the 6-hourly global models (ECMWF open data arrives ~7-8 h after its run, so up to ~14 h old); HRRR is hourly. Aging never gates; stale caps the verdict at marginal (docs/ios/PLAN.md Verdict). Owner decision 2026-09-26: hours, not days. Values are proposals; tune from field nights.

air_quality_forecast.note: CAMS Global via Open-Meteo Air Quality runs twice a day (00Z, 12Z) and arrives hours later, so a current run is normally up to ~22 h old.

smoke_forecast.note: RAP-Smoke via NDGD has one 03Z issue a day (docs/methods.md), ingested about 04:25Z (docs/methods.md), so the current issue is up to ~25.5 h old; 30 h leaves room for a late ingest. Past 48 h a daily issue has been missed.
